contexts.text: Thus one family... may be distinguished from another.
Distinguished into houses, families and nations... A family was composed of houses fewer or more, of which one dwelt not far from another, but still not together. AC 1159:3.

According to their families () = pairs... All things were now so reduced to order... as to represent families. With a regenerate man, goods and truths... have a mutual regard for each other... like families from one stock... AC 9079. AC 9807. AC 9841:end.
According to their families () = according to the probity of each.
The reason families = probity, and also charity and love, is that all things of charity and love are circumstanced in the Heavens as are consanguinities and affinities, thus as are families. AC 3612.
According to their families () = according to their morals.
According to their families () = according to their differences as to charity.
These are the families of the sons of Noah () = the worships of the Ancient Church in particular... No families can be meant but those of spiritual and celestial things.
Families = goods, when predicated of nations; and truths, when of peoples. Illustrated.
Cities, then, were families; and a number of families were a nation.
In thee shall all the families of the ground be blessed () = that all goods and truths are from the Lord... Families have a like signification to nations and peoples...
Each Society or family of Spirits...
In the Ancient Church... cities were cohabitations of separate families; the family of a single parent constituted a city. Example(s). AC 4478.
They had it from the most ancients that nations and families represented the heavenly Societies, thus the things of love and charity.
All things in man are as one house, that is, one family... AC 3129.
To my family () = the truth which is from the Divine.
Knowledges are circumstanced as are nations, families, and houses...
In thee shall all the families of the ground he blessed () = that all the truths of good of doctrine shall be conjoined with good... Families = goods, and also truths of good.
Each family has some peculiar evil or good by which it is distinguished from other families... SE 2426.
In Heaven... the varieties are disposed by the Lord so as to have relation to families, in which are brothers, sisters, etc.
The scientifics in the natural mind... are circumstanced not unlike families...
Each family within a tribe = a special good; thus the good of one in special as distinguished from the good of another.
The consociations of the sons of Israel according to tribes, families, and houses, represented the Societies in Heaven. Explained. AC 7836:3.

According to your families () = according to the good of each truth. Families, when said of the tons of Israel, by whom is represented the Spiritual Church, = the goods of truth... (For) families are the things which descend from good through truth, and are the goods of truth.
(The inhabitants of Jupiter) care little for worldly things; for families dwell together.
If (such wrong opinions) have crept into any family, that family is taken away from the midst of them... by privation of their breathing...
There are no cities (in Saturn), but they live distinguished into families... thus a man and wife with their children...
See Earth. AC 10813. AC 10836.
Under Dominion, see this reference.
The generation of spiritual families...
Certain from the families of Spirits.
The families of the earth = truths AE 355:23. AE 555:10.
There was such a correspondence of the families on earth with the Societies in the Heavens.
